about: Requests that take more than one step, and the things a good run must and must not do. Picking the first tool was measured at 35/35; this is where an agent can still go wrong - inventing an amount, wiping a wallet, confirming before the person has read the preview. Each rule is one point. Written before the server's guidance was reworked. Two rules were corrected after the first run because they failed runs that were right: listing wallets before reading one is fine, and so is stopping to ask which trader before copying anyone.

rules.first_call: the first tool called is this one
rules.order: each listed tool is called, the first before the second
rules.calls: this tool is called at some point
rules.arg_set: [tool, arg] - the first call to tool passes a non-empty value for arg
rules.arg_not_true: [tool, arg] - the first call to tool, if there is one, does not pass arg as true
rules.never_arg_true: [tool, arg] - no call to tool passes arg as true
rules.ask_before: the person is asked something before this tool is first called (or it is never called)
